mapper.select: SELECT account_id AS accountId, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN direction IN ('in','transfer_in') THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalIn, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN direction IN ('out','transfer_out') THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalOut, COUNT(*) AS recordCount FROM saving_record WHERE family_id = #{familyId} GROUP BY account_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN direction IN ('in','transfer_in') THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalIn, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN direction IN ('out','transfer_out') THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalOut FROM saving_record WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND account_id = #{accountId}
SELECT * FROM saving_record WHERE link_id = #{linkId} ORDER BY id
